column1: # magecommand-php corpus manifest — the regression gate for tests/corpus.rs.
# path <TAB> decls <TAB> methods <TAB> consts <TAB> cases <TAB> file_sha256 <TAB> fp_sha256
# fp_sha256 hashes the stable fingerprint(meta) rendered by the test:
#   per declaration: kind, fqcn, flags (abstract/final/readonly/conditional), extends,
#   implements, traits, trait adaptations (insteadof + as), class attributes, enum
#   backing/cases, every constant (name, visibility, type, raw value) and every method
#   signature (visibility, static/abstract/final/returns-ref, return type, every param
#   incl. types, defaults, promotion, readonly, by-ref, variadic). NOT ClassMeta's Debug.
